name: Thrill Seeker
description:
You love the thrill of danger.

Each time any of the following occurs, you take +1d on your next skill check made within the next minute:

  • You are forced to roll Dexterity for a contest and you win.

  • You roll Dexterity to avoid an attack, dodge an obstacle or otherwise skirt danger and you pass.

  • You take any amount of falling damage.

The bonuses are cumulative.

Describe how you thrive on adrenaline.
